title: Blood Binding
summary: A Book of Shadows knows the witch whose blood has bound it.
pages: You have written your name where names are not easily erased. Blood remembers what ink forgets.
What you have bound yourself to — and what has bound itself to you — remains to be seen. Only time will tell.
A witch may bind more than one Book of Shadows. Each copy carries the knowledge its witch has acquired. Another witch may hold your book, but its writing is not theirs to know.
